text:
Floor markings earlier today stayed on our minds, and thanks for your review. We understand that your complaint is about how the companion animal check-in process felt unclear and poorly supported, and that this left you uncertain about whether your pet was being handled with the care Aurelia Skyways promises.

Please accept our apology for the disruption. At the Companion Animal Travel Desk, we treat each journey as a shared responsibility, and when a traveler is left without clear guidance, we have not met that standard. Our welcome team is meant to prepare passengers and their animals for boarding with calm direction, careful review, and steady communication. When that process slips, the impact is felt not only by the traveler but by the pet as well.

The most useful next step is for you to keep a record of where the process broke down, including any staff interaction that felt incomplete or contradictory. This helps us trace the issue to the correct point in the service flow and improve the handoff between desk support, escort staff, and boarding preparation. If your animal was moved, held, or reassessed in a way that was not explained, please include that detail in your follow-up so we can review it against the service record and coaching notes.

We also encourage travelers to ask for a step-by-step summary at check-in when anything feels unclear. Our team should explain what happens next, who will assist, and what the traveler should expect before boarding begins. That is especially important for nervous pets, because steady handling and plain communication reduce stress for everyone involved.

Your feedback matters because it shows where our routine work needs more care. We will use it to reinforce clearer handoffs, better explanations, and more consistent attention from the first welcome through the final boarding check.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
